about.title: About the project
about.lead: A shared, machine-readable picture of who runs which IT systems and where which data is kept in the Swiss agri-food sector.

what.title: What is it?
what.p1: The DigiAgriFoodCH system map is a knowledge graph maintained by the Federal Office for Agriculture FOAG. It describes organizations, the IT systems they operate, the IT services these systems provide and use, and the data sets (datasets) they contain – together with their relations, protection needs and legal bases.
what.p2: This application offers three views on the same data: an overview with key figures, an interactive map that makes the graph structure visible, and an inventory to search and filter every documented element.

how.title: How it works
how.s1: The graph is published as Linked Data on the Swiss federal LINDAS platform.
how.s2: The browser loads the whole graph with a single query (about 170 kB compressed).
how.s3: The triples are parsed and turned into a typed model in a few milliseconds.
how.s4: All pages compute their views locally – filtering is instant, no server needed.
how.p: The query is sent before the application has even started and the last result is kept in the browser, so repeat visits appear instantly while a fresh copy is loaded in the background. Labels and descriptions are shown in the selected language, falling back to another language where no translation exists yet.
